title: When to Replace a Roof in Houston
description: The better week for a Houston roof replacement is a dry stretch you chose, not the week a storm is already in the Gulf.
html:
People wait for a hail claim or a leak in the hallway, then want the roof replaced while the next front is on the radar. The better week is one you pick, when the deck can dry and the crew is not tarping half the neighborhood.

The weather we actually get

Summer is workable if the mornings start early and the afternoon storms are watched. A tear-off that is dried in before the rain is a normal Houston day. A tear-off that sits open through a tropical system is not. Late fall and winter give more dry hours and shorter days. Hurricane season is not a reason to freeze every replacement. It is a reason not to open a roof the week a storm is named.

If a storm already opened the roof, the first job is a tarp, not a full replacement in the rain. That sequence is tarping a roof after a Texas storm and the storm and emergency page.

Do not wait for the label to expire

Replace it when the mat, the deck, or the leaks say so. The timing around that decision is in how long a Houston shingle roof lasts and repair the roof or replace it. Once you are ready, the install itself is roof replacement.
